archetypes.name: dyn-summary-contract
archetypes.rationale: Outcome display changes touch shared rendering and recovery paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the final-summary outcome display contract across the shared renderer, implement recovery reconciliation, and design degraded fallback. Check that success values map to DONE, stalled maps to STALLED, unknown outcomes stay raw, and implement Path and PR diagnostics remain intact. Pay special attention to duplicate Outcome bullets and legacy lowercase stalled reconciliation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
